name: prod_eq_zero_iff
statement: f.prod g = 0 ↔ ∃ i ∈ f.support, g i (f i) = 0

name: sum_sub_index
statement: β i), Decidable (x ≠ 0)] [AddCommGroup γ] {f g : Π₀ i, β i} {h : ∀ i, β i → γ} (h_sub : ∀ i b₁ b₂, h i (b₁ - b₂) = h i b₁ - h i b₂) : (f - g).sum h = f.sum h - g.sum h

have_tree.body: (liftAddHom fun a => AddMonoidHom.ofMapSub (h a) (h_sub a)).map_sub f g

name: sum_single
statement: β i), Decidable (x ≠ 0)] {f : Π₀ i, β i} : f.sum single = f
